# MSstatsPTM

MSstatsPTM is an R/Bioconductor package for statistical relative
quantification of post-translational modifications (PTMs) in mass
spectrometry-based proteomics experiments. It supports label-free DDA,
DIA, and SRM workflows as well as tandem mass tag (TMT) labeling. The
analysis jointly models the abundance of modified peptides (PTM sites)
and their corresponding unmodified proteins, then adjusts the PTM-level
changes for changes in overall protein abundance so that detected
differences reflect genuine changes in modification stoichiometry rather
than changes in protein expression. MSstatsPTM provides functions for
summarization, estimation of PTM-site abundance, and detection of
changes in PTMs across experimental conditions.

MSstatsPTM is part of the
[MSstats](https://github.com/Vitek-Lab/MSstats) family of packages,
developed and maintained by the [Vitek
Lab](https://olga-vitek-lab.khoury.northeastern.edu/) at Northeastern
University. The package and its documentation are also available at
[msstats.org](http://msstats.org).

## Installation

``` r

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install("MSstatsPTM")
```

The development version can be installed directly from this repository:

``` r

remotes::install_github("Vitek-Lab/MSstatsPTM")
```

## Quick Start

``` r

library(MSstatsPTM)

# Example label-free PTM + unmodified-protein data
data(raw.input)

# Summarize PTM and protein data to run level
summary <- dataSummarizationPTM(raw.input, use_log_file = FALSE)

# Define the comparison of interest
comparison <- matrix(c(-1, 0, 1, 0), nrow = 1)
row.names(comparison) <- "CCCP-Ctrl"
colnames(comparison) <- c("CCCP", "Combo", "Ctrl", "USP30_OE")

# Model PTM and protein levels, adjusting PTMs for protein abundance
model <- groupComparisonPTM(summary,
                            ptm_label_type = "LF",
                            protein_label_type = "LF",
                            contrast.matrix = comparison,
                            use_log_file = FALSE)

head(model$ADJUSTED.Model)
```

Real experiments typically start by converting a search tool’s output
into MSstatsPTM format with one of the `*toMSstatsPTMFormat()`
converters below, then proceed with
[`dataSummarizationPTM()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/dataSummarizationPTM.md)
and
[`groupComparisonPTM()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/groupComparisonPTM.md)
as above. See the vignettes for complete, tool-specific examples.

## Supported Converters

MSstatsPTM does not read raw search-tool output directly. Instead, a
converter translates each tool’s PTM and protein reports into MSstatsPTM
format before
[`dataSummarizationPTM()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/dataSummarizationPTM.md)
is called:

| Search tool / format | Converter function |
|----|----|
| Skyline | [`SkylinetoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/SkylinetoMSstatsPTMFormat.md) |
| MaxQuant | [`MaxQtoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/MaxQtoMSstatsPTMFormat.md) |
| Progenesis | [`ProgenesistoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/ProgenesistoMSstatsPTMFormat.md) |
| Spectronaut | [`SpectronauttoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/SpectronauttoMSstatsPTMFormat.md) |
| Proteome Discoverer | [`PDtoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/PDtoMSstatsPTMFormat.md) |
| DIA-NN | [`DIANNtoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/DIANNtoMSstatsPTMFormat.md) |
| FragPipe | [`FragPipetoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/FragPipetoMSstatsPTMFormat.md) |
| Metamorpheus | [`MetamorpheusToMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/MetamorpheusToMSstatsPTMFormat.md) |
| Protein Prospector | [`ProteinProspectortoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/ProteinProspectortoMSstatsPTMFormat.md) |
| Peak Studio | [`PStoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/PStoMSstatsPTMFormat.md) |

See the
[label-free](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/vignettes/MSstatsPTM_LabelFree_Workflow.Rmd)
and
[TMT](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/vignettes/MSstatsPTM_TMT_Workflow.Rmd)
workflow vignettes for the required input files and options for each
converter.

## Getting Help / Reporting Bugs

- **Questions about usage, statistical methods, or troubleshooting:**
  please post to the [MSstats Google
  Group](https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/msstats). This is
  monitored by the development team and searchable, so it’s the fastest
  way to get help and to see if your question has already been answered.
- **Bug reports and feature requests for this repository:** please open
  a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/Vitek-Lab/MSstatsPTM/issues).

## References

If you use MSstatsPTM, please cite:

1.  Kohler D, Tsai TH, Verschueren E, Huang T, Hinkle T, Phu L, Choi M,
    Vitek O. **MSstatsPTM: Statistical Relative Quantification of
    Posttranslational Modifications in Bottom-Up Mass Spectrometry-Based
    Proteomics.** *Mol Cell Proteomics*. 2022;22(1):100477. [DOI:
    10.1016/j.mcpro.2022.100477](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.mcpro.2022.100477)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`DIANNtoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/DIANNtoMSstatsPTMFormat.md)
  : Convert the output of DIA-NN PSM file into MSstatsPTM format
- [`FragPipetoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/FragPipetoMSstatsPTMFormat.md)
  : Convert output of TMT labeled Fragpipe data into MSstatsPTM format.
- [`MSstatsPTMSiteLocator()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/MSstatsPTMSiteLocator.md)
  : Locate modification site number and amino acid
- [`MaxQtoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/MaxQtoMSstatsPTMFormat.md)
  : Convert output of label-free or TMT MaxQuant experiments into
  MSstatsPTM format
- [`MetamorpheusToMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/MetamorpheusToMSstatsPTMFormat.md)
  : Import Metamorpheus files into PTM format
- [`PDtoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/PDtoMSstatsPTMFormat.md)
  : Convert Proteome Discoverer output into MSstatsPTM format
- [`PStoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/PStoMSstatsPTMFormat.md)
  : Convert Peaks Studio output into MSstatsPTM format
- [`ProgenesistoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/ProgenesistoMSstatsPTMFormat.md)
  : Converts non-TMT Progenesis output into the format needed for
  MSstatsPTM
- [`ProteinProspectortoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/ProteinProspectortoMSstatsPTMFormat.md)
  : Generate MSstatsPTM required input format from Protein Prospector
  output
- [`SkylinetoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/SkylinetoMSstatsPTMFormat.md)
  : Convert Skyline output into MSstatsPTM format
- [`SpectronauttoMSstatsPTMFormat()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/SpectronauttoMSstatsPTMFormat.md)
  : Convert Spectronaut output into MSstatsPTM format
- [`annotSite()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/annotSite.md)
  : Annotate modification site
- [`dataProcessPTM()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/dataProcessPTM.md)
  : Data processing and summarization of peptide-level quantification to
  PTM and protein level quantification
- [`dataProcessPlotsPTM()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/dataProcessPlotsPTM.md)
  : Visualization for explanatory data analysis
- [`dataSummarizationPTM()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/dataSummarizationPTM.md)
  : Data summarization function for label-free MS experiments targeting
  PTMs.
- [`dataSummarizationPTM_TMT()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/dataSummarizationPTM_TMT.md)
  : Data summarization function for TMT labelled MS experiments
  targeting PTMs.
- [`designSampleSizePTM()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/designSampleSizePTM.md)
  : Planning future experimental designs of PTM experiments in sample
  size calculation
- [`.fixTerminus()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/dot-fixTerminus.md)
  : Fix terminus location adjustments
- [`fragpipe_annotation`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/fragpipe_annotation.md)
  : Example annotation file for a TMT FragPipe experiment.
- [`fragpipe_annotation_protein`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/fragpipe_annotation_protein.md)
  : Example annotation file for a global profiling run TMT FragPipe
  experiment.
- [`fragpipe_input`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/fragpipe_input.md)
  : Output of FragPipe TMT PTM experiment
- [`fragpipe_input_protein`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/fragpipe_input_protein.md)
  : Output of FragPipe TMT global profiling experiment
- [`groupComparisonPTM()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/groupComparisonPTM.md)
  : Perform differential analysis on MS-based proteomics experiments
  targeting PTMs
- [`groupComparisonPlotsPTM()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/groupComparisonPlotsPTM.md)
  : Visualization for model-based analysis and summarization
- [`locateMod()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/locateMod.md)
  : Locate modified sites with a peptide
- [`locatePTM()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/locatePTM.md)
  : Annotate modified sites with associated peptides
- [`maxq_lf_annotation`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/maxq_lf_annotation.md)
  : Example annotation file for a label-free MaxQuant experiment.
- [`maxq_lf_evidence`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/maxq_lf_evidence.md)
  : Example MaxQuant evidence file from the output of a label free
  experiment
- [`maxq_tmt_annotation`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/maxq_tmt_annotation.md)
  : Example annotation file for a TMT MaxQuant experiment.
- [`maxq_tmt_evidence`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/maxq_tmt_evidence.md)
  : Example MaxQuant evidence file from the output of a TMT experiment
- [`pd_annotation`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/pd_annotation.md)
  : Example annotation file for a label-free Proteome Discoverer
  experiment.
- [`pd_psm_input`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/pd_psm_input.md)
  : Example Proteome Discoverer evidence file from the output of a label
  free experiment
- [`pd_testing_output`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/pd_testing_output.md)
  : Example output of Proteome Discoverer converter
- [`raw.input`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/raw.input.md)
  : Example of input PTM dataset for LabelFree/DDA/DIA experiments.
- [`raw.input.tmt`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/raw.input.tmt.md)
  : Example of input PTM dataset for TMT experiments.
- [`spectronaut_annotation`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/spectronaut_annotation.md)
  : Example annotation file for a label-free Spectronaut experiment.
- [`spectronaut_input`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/spectronaut_input.md)
  : Example Spectronaut evidence file from the output of a label free
  experiment
- [`summary.data`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/summary.data.md)
  : Example of output from dataSummarizationPTM function for non-TMT
  data
- [`summary.data.tmt`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/summary.data.tmt.md)
  : Example of output from dataSummarizationPTM_TMT function for TMT
  data
- [`tidyFasta()`](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MSstatsPTM/reference/tidyFasta.md)
  : Read and tidy a FASTA file
